g.text: Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: 14 schedule rows of docs-authority/nozzles/WAFER_FAB.csv at tag, face and bore

Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: Inlets on -Y at z 160: N1 DN15 (N2 purge), N2 DN15 (B/P/As concentrate), N3 DN15 (colloidal silica slurry), N4 DN25 (fab UPW), N11/N12/N14 DN15 (the solids transfer rows); outlets on +Y at z 600: N5/N6/N7 DN15, N8 DN25 (spent UPW), N13 DN15 (spent resist and solvent)
Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: N9 drain flush at the envelope bottom (50 datum); N10 vent flush at the envelope top (800 datum is the box top)

Graph revision AD - nozzle_orient: Atmospheric open-bore tube stubs per duty section 4 (nozzle DN15, no flange class); the solids rows are non-piped transfers drawn DN15, bore not calculated (plan W4); the schedule rating column (Class 150) carried verbatim as text
